Method of Attack: Spreads malware to victim's friends on Discord
Modifies Discord client's JavaScript files to steal Discord user tokens
Logs user out and prompts login to capture credentials
Uses Discord webhook to send stolen credentials and IP address to attacker-controlled Discord channel
Listens for attacker commands to spread malware via victim's Discord friends
Does not stay resident or run again after infection, evading antivirus detection
Attack Vector: Distributed on Discord disguised as game cheat, hacking tool, or copyrighted software
Spread for free on hacker forums and YouTube videos explaining how to steal Discord tokens
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of 4n4rchy folder with inject.js and discordmod.js JavaScript files
Modified Discord client logs user out and prompts login
Discord webhook sending user's email, login name, user token, plain text password, and IP address to attacker
